description: Maximo API for WP Edit Settings
title: WPEDITSETTING

editasset.title: Asset
editasset.remarks: Specifies whether the asset can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work order's asset. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work order's asset.

plusgeditbypchkl.title: Checklist
plusgeditbypchkl.remarks: Specifies whether the checklist fields in the Bypass Management application can be edited when the Bypass Management record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the checklist fields can be edited.

editwpmat.title: WP Materials
editwpmat.remarks: Specifies whether the work plan materials can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work plan materials. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work plan materials.

editwpser.title: WP Service
editwpser.remarks: Specifies whether the work plan services can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work plan services. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work plan services.

plusgeditmocprelist.title: Pre-start Actions
plusgeditmocprelist.remarks: Specifies whether pre-start actions in the MOC application can be edited when the management of change record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the pre-start actions can be edited.

plusceditpoint.title: Edit Cal Point
plusceditpoint.remarks: When selected, you can add a calibration point to a work order data sheet that is in the selected status. For example, you can opt to add a calibration point to a work order data sheet only when the work order is in the In Progress or Waiting for Materials statuses.

editloc.title: Location
editloc.remarks: Specifies whether the location can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work order's location. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work order's location.

plusgeditmocauth.title: Authorization
plusgeditmocauth.remarks: Specifies whether authorization information in the MOC application can be edited when the management of change record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the authorization information can be edited.

editglaccount.title: GL Account
editglaccount.remarks: Specifies whether the general ledger account can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work order's general ledger account. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work order's general ledger account.

editwplab.title: WP Labor
editwplab.remarks: Specifies whether the work plan labor can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work plan labor. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work plan labor.

plusgeditmocpssr.title: Pre-Start Safety Review
plusgeditmocpssr.remarks: Specifies whether the Pre-Start Safety Review in the MOC application can be edited when the MOC record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the Pre-Start Safety Review can be edited.

plusgeditbyprev.title: Review and Approval
plusgeditbyprev.remarks: Specifies whether the review and approval fields in the Bypass Management application can be edited when the Bypass Management record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the review and approval fields can be edited.

plusceditafal.title: As Found / As Left
plusceditafal.remarks: When selected, you can edit the As Found and As Left values on a work order data sheet that is in the selected status. For example, you can opt to allow for the editing of As Found and As Left values only when the work order is in the In Progress or Waiting for Materials statuses.

plusgeditmocrev.title: Review and Approval
plusgeditmocrev.remarks: Specifies whether review and approval information in the MOC application can be edited when the management of change record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the review and approval information can be edited.

applydjp.title: Dynamic Job Plan
applydjp.remarks: Indicates if the dynamic job plan can be recalculated when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can perform the dynamic job plan calculation.

plusgeditmocpostlist.title: Post-start Actions
plusgeditmocpostlist.remarks: Specifies whether post-start actions in the MOC application can be edited when the management of change record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the post-start actions can be edited.

plusceditds.title: New Data Sheet
plusceditds.remarks: When selected, you can add a data sheet to a work order when the work order is in the selected status. For example, you can opt to add a data sheet to a work order when the work order is in the In Progress status.

editwptool.title: WP Tools
editwptool.remarks: Specifies whether the work plan tools can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the work plan tools. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the work plan tools.

plusgeditbenefit.title: Costs and Benefits
plusgeditbenefit.remarks: Specifies whether cost and benefit information for an improvement can be edited when the improvement record has the corresponding status. If this check box is selected, the cost and benefit information can be edited.

editsafety.title: Safety Tab
editsafety.remarks: Specifies whether safety information can be edited when the work order is in the selected status. If the check box is selected, you can edit the safety information. If the check box is cleared, you cannot edit the safety information.

plusgeditbyprvac.title: Review Action
plusgeditbyprvac.remarks: You can allow changes when Bypass Management records are in a particular status. For example, to allow updates to reviewers or approvers when the status of a Bypass Management record is Waiting for Approval, select the check box that is in the Review and Approval column and in the WAPPR row.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: Status at which fields are editable. For each field in the row, select the check box to make the field editable when the work order is at the indicated status level. Clear the check box for each field to disable editing at that status level.
